P1: 8号道路 connects 金黄市 in the west and 紫苑镇 in the east. The eastern end of the second Underground Path can be found here, but the door is locked and authorities have closed the tunnel indefinitely due to rowdy behavior.
D1: West end of the paved road
D2: Northwest of the exit to Lavender Town, on a tree (daily)
P2: 紫苑镇 is a quiet, somber town. The area was once known for its frequent ghost sightings in 宝可梦塔, where departed Pokémon were laid to rest. In an attempt to modernize, the town converted the building in recent years into the Kanto Radio Tower. The Pokémon interred here were moved to the House of Memories in the southeast part of town, where they remain under the watchful eye of Mr. Fuji.
P3: The Kanto Radio Tower has been on high alert ever since Johto's Radio Tower was taken over by Team Rocket, and visitors are now restricted to the first floor. Due to a service interruption at the Power Plant, none of the programs can be broadcast at the moment.
P4: The House of Memories was built to accommodate the departed Pokémon from the former 宝可梦塔. There are several graves on the ground floor, and many more located in underground chambers that are off-limits to all but the caretaker, Mr. Fuji.
P5: The Lavender Volunteer Pokémon House is located in the center of town. Founded by Mr. Fuji, the organization was established to care for orphaned and abandoned Pokémon. Many members of the group live here in their safe house while looking after these Pokémon.
P6: One of the houses on the south side of town belongs to the Name Rater. This man judges a Trainer's nickname for their Pokémon, and offers the chance to change it. His service is free so nicknames may be changed repeatedly.
P7: 10号道路 connects 紫苑镇 to 9号道路 in the north. Much of the route is occupied by a river and the grounds of the 无人发电厂. Anyone traveling through the area must venture through the dim interior of 岩山隧道. A remote Pokémon Center is located near the north end of the cave.
D3: In a clearing on the west side of the middle level (requires 怪力)
P8: As it has been left in its natural state and undeveloped, 岩山隧道 is pitch-black inside. Though not required, it is useful to bring a Pokémon that can use 闪光 to illuminate the winding tunnels.
D5: South; on a lone stalagmite in the southeast area (hidden)
D6: South; on the ridge in the center of 1F
D7: South; dead-end path in the west-southwest area
D8: Northwest; south side of the ridge, on a lone stalagmite (hidden)
D11: Northeast; southeast area, in a stone wall behind two breakable rocks (hidden; requires 碎岩)
D12: Northeast; in the lower, central area
D14: B1F (Southwest); western-most of the small southern chambers (requires 攀岩)
D15: B1F (Southwest); second southern chamber from the west, on a rock (hidden; requires 攀岩)
D16: B1F (Southwest); eastern-most of the small southern chambers (requires 攀岩)
P9: Climb onto the first ridge and go east. Turn north to reach a second ridge and 招式学习器56（投掷）. Return to the first ridge and continue westward. Take the narrow northern path to reach an ＰＰ多项小补剂, then climb down the ladder in the southwest area.
P10: Go eastward along the cliff's edge. There are several smaller chambers to the south that are inaccessible without 攀岩. Turn north instead and climb up the west-central ladder.
P11: Head east, then circle around and pass over the northern ridge. Climb down the ladder in the northwest area.
P12: Go east along the first pair of stairways to reach a 活力碎片, then return to the ladder. Follow the second pair of stairways eastward, and go down the next stairway to find a ＰＰ提升剂 in the central area. Continue eastward and climb up the next ladder.
P13: Follow the tunnel eastward to reach the exit.
P14: 9号道路 is a rocky, uneven mountain road that links 10号道路 to 华蓝市.
D17: Northwest of the eastern grass patch, in the white flowers near the river (hidden)
D18: East end of the lower, south-central area
D19: Above the northeast ledge (requires 居合斩)
D20: Above a ledge, between the western and central grass patches(requires 居合斩)
D21: Southwest part of the route, in the dirt-covered area
P15: One of the men inside the Pokémon Center mentions how the last time he was passing by the Power Plant, he heard someone yelling about a thief. He believes that it was the Manager's voice that he heard. Go north from the building to reach a river, then use 冲浪 to follow the water southward to the facility.
M1: The same as the traded Pokémon
D22: West of the Power Plant entrance (hidden)
D23: Power Plant; held by Maggie, a 三合一磁怪 received through a trade
D25: Power Plant; from the Manager, after returning the 机械零件
P16: The 无人发电厂 building had previously been abandoned, but was recently renovated in order to power the region more efficiently. The electricity generated here powers all sorts of things, including the Magnet Train.
P17: A Super Nerd can be found sitting at a desk near the rear wall. He is willing to part with his 三合一磁怪 in exchange for a 三地鼠. Dugtrio can only be found in 地鼠洞穴, but its pre-evolved form, 地鼠, can also be found in other areas.
P18: Visit the back of the building and speak to the man overlooking the generator. The Manager reveals that a thief has stolen an essential piece from the new generator, forcing it offline.
P19: As you approach the exit, the security guard is alerted to a shady character in 华蓝市, and asks that you investigate for them. He informs you that the man was last seen loitering around the Cerulean Gym.
